ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis.B-7/91, dated
13-6-1991.--The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 8th May, 1991 and assented to by
the-Governor of Sindh on 4th June, 1991 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 58 of Sindh Ordinance No. XII of 1979

ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis.B-7/91, dated
13-6-1991.--The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 8th May, 1991 and assented to by
the-Governor of Sindh on 4th June, 1991 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 58 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XII of 1979.---In the Sindh Local government Ordinance,
1979, in section 58, after subsection (1), the following new subsection shall
be inserted:--
"(1-A)
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, extend the period
under subsection (1) but such extension shall not exceed six months."

Repeal
